description: After the user approves the story and exact social destinations, publish now to destinations this content has not reached, reusing the same ID even if already published. Keep published content unchanged. Use one unique Idempotency-Key per approved request; reuse it with identical settings after a lost response. Poll getStory for platform IDs and results. Acceptance does not confirm delivery; never retry an uncertain outcome with a new key.

allOf.description: Use one key per approved publish. Repeat the same key and settings after a lost response; never make a new key for an uncertain result.

Idempotency-Key.description: Use one key per approved publish. Repeat the same key and settings after a lost response; never make a new key for an uncertain result.

name: publishStory
